### `create_folder_view`

**Create Folder View** · `POST /api/v2/folder/{folder_id}/view` · API v2 · 🟡 write

Add a List, Board, Calendar, Table, Timeline, Workload, Activity, Map, Chat, or Gantt view to a Folder.

| Argument | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `folder_id` | path | number | yes |  |
| `body` | body | object | yes | JSON request body, fields below. |

<summary><code>body</code> fields (35)</summary>

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `type` | string | yes | The type of view to create. Options include: `list`, `board`, `calendar`, `table`, `timeline`, `workload`, `activity`, `map`, `conversation`, or `gantt`. |
| `grouping` | object | yes |  |
| `grouping.field` | string | yes | Set the field to group by. Options include: `none`, `status`, `priority`, `assignee`, `tag`, or `dueDate`. |
| `grouping.dir` | integer | yes | Set a group sort order using `1` or `-1`. For example, use `1`show tasks with urgent priority at the top of your view, and tasks with no priority at the bottom. Use `-1` to reverse the order to show tasks with no priority at the top of your view. |

| `sorting` | object | yes |  |

| `filters` | object | yes |  |
| `filters.op` | string | yes | The available operator (`op``) values are `AND`` and `OR``. |
| `filters.fields[]` | string[] | yes | View the list of [fields available](https://developer.clickup.com/docs/filter-views) to filter by. |
| `filters.search` | string | yes |  |
| `filters.show_closed` | boolean | yes |  |
